description: Caltrans Districts is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The District boundary definitions are primarily based on the California county boundaries. The Board of Equalization (BOE) County and City Boundary web service is the authoritative source of County boundaries and this was used to digitize the district boundaries based on the data from March 2023. This data is solely for informational purposes. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Boundary, CalSTA, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans, Government Units, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData. The bounding box given is -124.4820,32.5288,-114.1308,42.0095. The hub shows 2023-03-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
